spec.title: Fleet Health — one row per node (sorted by blocks behind the leader)

spec.expr: 100 * sum by (instance) (increase(blocknode_verification_blocks_verified_total{environment="$environment", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance) (increase(blocknode_verification_blocks_received_total{environment="$environment", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])), 1)

sum by (instance) (increase(blocknode_verification_block_time_total{environment="$environment", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance) (increase(blocknode_verification_blocks_verified_total{environment="$environment", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])), 1)

sum by (instance) (increase(blocknode_messaging_block_items_received_total{environment="$environment", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance) (increase(blocknode_verification_blocks_verified_total{environment="$environment", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])), 1)
